text:
maria: Heads up — I'm seeing token-level tail spikes on /chat-prod starting last night. The distribution shows a sharp bump around token 120-140. Suspect KV prefix cache churn and more kernel switches. Can we add a token-level latency breakdown + per-route KV reuse panels to the runtime dashboard? cc @kai @olivia

kai: Yup, saw that too in the sampling logs. I'll add panels for token.latency.{kv_lookup_ms,kernel_exec_ms,decode_ms} split by token_index and route. Want p50/p95/p99 lines.

olivia: I'll expose these metrics from the kvcache agent: kvcache.hit_rate, kvcache.evictions_total, kvcache.memory_bytes, kvcache.reuse_by_route (label=route). Also will add a gauge for kvcache.inflight_loads to see concurrent misses.

jon: Please include reuse_percent = reuse_by_route / requests_by_route so we can compare traffic vs reuse. Also add a small table: top 10 routes by eviction contribution and average token position of misses.

frank: quick note — we rolled batching heuristic tweak last week (batch_wait_ms lowered from 6 -> 3ms for low-latency tier). That reduces throughput but can raise kernel churn if misses line up. I'll run the profiler and attach a flamegraph.

maria: here's a PromQL snippet I used locally for the token phase breakdown:```sum by (route,token_index) (rate(token_latency_ms_sum{phase="kv_lookup"}[5m])) / sum by (route,token_index) (rate(token_latency_ms_count{phase="kv_lookup"}[5m]))```

frank: sharing initial profile: saw repeated kernel reloads tied to route '/chat-prod' at ~03:12 UTC. attaching flame URL in the dashboard once panels are live.

perf-bot: regression alert: 2026-03-14T03:12:08Z — KV miss rate increased +8% on /chat-prod vs baseline.

olivia: plan: I'll add metrics and a grafana panel (reuse heatmap + evictions waterfall). Kai will add token-level series. Frank will attach profiler traces and we iterate on filter thresholds for cache eviction.

maria: thanks — if we can get per-token phase breakdown + per-route reuse in the A/B canary this afternoon, we can decide on reverting batching tweak or adjusting eviction thresholds. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: dashboard change deployed to staging (dash id: runtime-kv-token-breakdown)

kai: I'll PR the dashboard panels now and link the PR here.

jon: tagging SRE for visibility if we need to roll capacity or pin kernels.

maria: ack, will follow up after we collect 1 hour of data and check p99 tails.
